Proposition
[Decay of the isoperimetric constant] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0109 ↗ lem:chow-iv-isoperimetric-ratio-evolution ↗ lem:chow-iv-isoperimetric-rigidity 1. ch29:29.21\group Isoperimetry

If the ancient solution is not round, then $I(t)<4\pi $, $I(t)\to 0$ as $t\to -\infty $, and $I(t)$ obeys the quantitative backward decay estimate stated in (29.64)--(29.65).
